# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/push_mirrors

Lists all push mirrors of a repository with pagination

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-236`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []PushMirror

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `repo_name` | string | Source repository name |
| `remote_name` | string | Git remote name |
| `remote_address` | string | Remote URL being mirrored to |
| `created` | datetime | Creation timestamp |
| `last_update` | datetime | Last sync timestamp |
| `last_error` | string | Last error message |
| `interval` | string | Sync interval duration string |
| `sync_on_commit` | boolean | Whether to sync on every commit |

- **400** — Mirror feature disabled
- **403** — User is not repo admin
- **404** — Repo not found or error fetching mirrors
